prompt: Which Trust Services Criteria apply to a SOC 2 Type 2 examination with a period starting January 2027?
assertions: States the 2017 TSC (with 2022 revised points of focus) apply, because the 2027 criteria are only a proposal
Notes the proposed criteria would apply to engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027 if adopted
Mentions early adoption would be permitted once the criteria are final
Confirms the five categories (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, Privacy) are unchanged
Recommends monitoring the exposure draft and commenting by January 15, 2027
